data.title: As Washington state’s AI task force winds down, the debate over how much to regulate is far from settled
data.description: Washington's AI task force wrapped up two years of work with the state's first AI laws on the books and its broader recommendations stalled in the Legislature. At a panel marking the end of the effort, consumer and labor advocates pushed for stronger rules while AI startups warned about the cost of complying.
data.author: Grace Kaste
